title: RetrievalRequest
description: Query sent to Component 3 (GraphRAG regulatory retrieval) by Component 1 (orchestrator) or Component 4 (assurance). Owner: C3.

request_id.description: Caller-generated ID, echoed in the response and used for pipeline tracing.

query_text.description: Natural-language question or tax scenario. PII must already be redacted by the caller.

as_of_date.description: Point-in-time date (YYYY-MM-DD). Only rules in force on this date are treated as applicable. Use today's date for current law; use a past date for an earlier year of assessment.

income_types.description: Optional filter: income types the scenario involves.

taxpayer_category.description: Optional filter: who the rule must apply to.

rule_types.description: Optional filter: only return these kinds of rule.

rule_ids.description: Optional: fetch these exact rules (e.g. C4 re-checking a citation C1 used).

top_k.description: Maximum number of rules to return.

include_history.description: If true, also return replaced/outdated versions of matched rules (status != active), not only the version applicable on as_of_date.
